info.description: REST API for Spotlight — a community events platform
info.title: Spotlight API

post.description: Saves the provided FCM token for the currently authenticated user. This token can be used to send push notifications to the user's device.
post.summary: Save a Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) token for the authenticated user

parameters.description: Request body containing the FCM token
parameters.name: body

400.description: Bad Request: invalid request body or missing token

500.description: Internal Server Error: failed to save token

get.description: Retrieves the profile information of the currently authenticated user

200.description: Returns a JSON object containing the user's profile information

500.description: Error occurred while selecting user details

delete.description: Anonymizes the currently authenticated user's account and removes associated data

500.description: Failed to anonymize user" or "Failed to delete registrations" or "Failed to commit

patch.description: Updates the profile information of the currently authenticated user

400.description: Invalid form data" or "Invalid gender value" or "Age must be between 13 and 120

500.description: Failed to update profile" or "Failed to read avatar" or "Failed to upload avatar

post.description: Sends an OTP to the provided email address for authentication

parameters.description: Request body containing the email address
parameters.name: body

500.description: Error in hashing" or "Inserting OTP failed" or "Failed to send OTP email

post.description: Verifies the provided OTP for the given email address and returns a JWT token if successful

parameters.description: Request body containing the email address and OTP
parameters.name: body

500.description: Failed to create user" or "Failed to create token

get.description: Returns a list of events that the currently authenticated user is either hosting or attending. Each event includes its ID, title, image URL, start time, and whether the user is the host.
get.summary: Get a list of chats for the authenticated user

200.description: Returns a JSON object containing a list of chat events

500.description: Internal Server Error: failed to fetch chats

get.description: Returns a Firebase custom token for the currently authenticated user to access the chat for a specific event. The user must be either the host or an accepted attendee of the event.
get.summary: Get a chat token for an event

200.description: Returns a JSON object containing the chat token

403.description: Forbidden: user is not an accepted attendee or host

500.description: Internal Server Error: failed to create chat token

get.description: Returns a list of events based on the provided query parameters. Supports filtering by host user ID, page ID, date range, city, tags, and search term. Pagination is supported via limit and offset.

parameters.description: Filter events starting from this date (RFC3339 format)
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Filter events ending before this date (RFC3339 format)
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Filter by tag IDs (can be specified multiple times)
parameters.name: tag_id

parameters.description: Search term for event title or description
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Number of events to skip for pagination (default: 0)
parameters.name: offset

200.description: Returns a JSON object containing a list of events and the count

500.description: Internal Server Error: failed to fetch events

post.description: Creates a new event with the provided details. The authenticated user will be set as the host of the event.

parameters.description: City where the event is held
parameters.name: city

parameters.description: List of tag IDs associated with the event
parameters.name: tag_ids

500.description: Internal Server Error: failed to create event

get.description: Returns a list of events that the currently authenticated user is registered for, either as a host or an accepted attendee.
get.summary: Get a list of events the user is registered for

parameters.description: Number of events to skip for pagination (default: 0)
parameters.name: offset

200.description: Returns a JSON object containing a list of registered events and the count

500.description: Internal Server Error: failed to fetch registered events

get.description: Returns a list of events that the currently authenticated user has attended but not yet rated. This allows users to provide feedback on events they have participated in.
get.summary: Get unrated events for the authenticated user

200.description: Returns a JSON object containing a list of unrated events

500.description: Internal Server Error: failed to fetch unrated events

get.description: Returns the details of a specific event by its ID. The authenticated user must be either the host or an accepted attendee of the event.

403.description: Forbidden: user is not authorized to view this event

404.description: Not Found: event does not exist

500.description: Internal Server Error: failed to fetch event

post.description: Cancels a specific event if the authenticated user is the host.

403.description: Forbidden: user is not authorized to cancel this event

404.description: Not Found: event does not exist

500.description: Internal Server Error: failed to cancel event

get.description: Returns the dashboard data for a specific event. Only the host of the event can access this endpoint.

403.description: Forbidden: only the host can view the dashboard

404.description: Not Found: event does not exist

500.description: Internal Server Error: failed to load dashboard

post.description: Allows the currently authenticated user to dismiss the rating prompt for a specific event. This indicates that the user does not wish to provide a rating for that event at this time.
post.summary: Dismiss the rating prompt for an event

204.description: No Content: rating prompt dismissed successfully

500.description: Internal Server Error: failed to dismiss rating prompt

post.description: Adds the authenticated user to the list of attendees for a specific event.

403.description: Forbidden: user is not authorized to join this event

404.description: Not Found: event does not exist

500.description: Internal Server Error: failed to join event

post.description: Allows the authenticated user to leave a specific event they are registered for.

404.description: Not Found: registration does not exist

500.description: Internal Server Error: failed to leave event

post.description: Allows the currently authenticated user to submit a rating for another user (either the host or an attendee) of a specific event. The rating includes a score, optional comment, and optional tags.
post.summary: Submit a rating for an event

parameters.description: Request body containing ratee_id, rating_type, score, comment, and tags
parameters.name: body

400.description: Bad Request: invalid input or constraints not met

403.description: Forbidden: user not allowed to rate the specified user

500.description: Internal Server Error: failed to submit rating

put.description: Updates the registration status (pending, accepted, rejected) for a specific user attending an event. Only the host of the event can perform this action.
put.summary: Update registration status for an event attendee

parameters.description: JSON body containing the new status
parameters.name: body

403.description: Forbidden: only the host can manage registrations

404.description: Not Found: event or registration does not exist

500.description: Internal Server Error: failed to update registration status

get.description: Returns a list of all available tags in the system. Each tag includes its ID and name.

200.description: Returns a JSON object containing a list of tags

500.description: Internal Server Error: failed to fetch tags

get.description: Returns the profile information of a specific host, including their ID, name, bio, and avatar URL.

200.description: Returns a JSON object containing the host's profile information

500.description: Internal Server Error: failed to load profile
